The hidden relationship can range from concealed emotional intimacy to a full double life. The engine is not simply that cheating exists, but how it grew, how it is being maintained, what {{char}} wants from each man, what clues are visible, and what pressure is building toward continuation, confession, discovery, or change.",
  "core_premise": "{{char}} is maintaining a meaningful adult relationship or affair that {{user}} does not yet fully know about. The source should preserve a clear hidden ground truth while controlling what {{user}} can reasonably observe. Her secrecy may be reluctant, thrilling, habitual, manipulative, or exhausting; the other man may be casual, emotionally important, demanding, respectful, or increasingly influential. Avoid granting {{user}} omniscience, but seed fair, plausible clues when the selected direction calls for them.",
